decisions.originalStructure: 1997 Ultra genuine base 350, Series One #1-200 / Series Two #201-350; first 173 are original veterans and #174–198 original Rookie subset. Four teamless physical checklists excluded from both 346-card medallions.
decisions.sourceAuthenticity: MCB 350 exact individually numbered source team subjects, 14 numbered insert tables, 346+346 exact G/P printed numbers, 15 actual Reebok-player numbers and genuine Lucky 13 and display crosschecked with TCDB. MCB card total only 1229 and collapses original distinct variations; this audit also includes TCDB-listed variants.
decisions.base: The original issued first series 200 and second 150, no manufactured extra rookies or checklists. Preserve RC designation as collector metadata, not part of printed player identity.
decisions.medallions: Gold G1–G198 and G201–G348, Platinum P1–P198 and P201–P348, actual 346 each, excludes G/P199,200,349,350. Real source variation G1b Blue Back Brett Favre is separately catalogued. Printed prefixes preserved exactly.
decisions.brownbacks: Beckett documents a distinct 173-card Ultra Brown Backs group: original Series One veteran cards #1–173. Brown backs are not a made-up parallel or a fully printed 350-card set. No invented specific pull odds.
decisions.twoExtraInserts: TCDB authentic Blitzkrieg Die Cut 18 and Rookies Gold Embossed 12 omitted from shorter MCB. Original physical printed card number and player/team from parent inserts retained, artwork must use proper physical variation.
decisions.odds: TCDB published full distinct odds on 16 insert families, original Series noted per group in metadata. Gold guaranteed one per HOBBY pack, Platinum replaces Gold 1:100 Hobby packs, with original manufacturer-estimated Platinum print run under 150. Reebok in specially marked packs only, Lucky 13 autographed via mail only.
decisions.specialIssues: Actual 5-color x15 Reebok-logo family, original 15 specific base card numbers, TCDB documented five unique back-print colors; genuine oversized Terrell Davis display, separate original NNO Terrell Davis sample and autographed promo and single NNO printed offer. Never let display, samples, offers or redemption autograph appear in regular wax.
decisions.imageAuthenticity: Do not create visual fake parallels or reuse the base player photograph for distinct veteran medallion shots. Card scans and unique foil/die cut/different backs must be authentic sources.
decisions.release: Product unreleased until original scans, pack+box image, pricing and proper two-series Hobby/Retail/ Reebok/ mail-in/case/promo rules implemented. Do not assign fake odds or mix nonexistent cards into regular packs.
